Page-by-Page Navigation Architecture, Triggers & State Transitions

g.text: • Authenticated learners who close the browser can resume their drafted application immediately upon signing in.
• Continuing learners with verified past records are automatically offered a 1-click expedited re-enrollment card.
• If the registrar closes the intake window globally, all enrollment forms cleanly redirect to an official announcement banner.
Choose Grade 7-12, applicant type, prior school.
> Click Proceed > Autosaves draft to LocalStorage.
Enter 12-digit LRN, PSA cert no., DOB, age.
Parents' legal names & emergency phone contact.
JHS Regular/SPS; SHS Track & Strand selection.
Upload PSA Birth Cert & Form 138 report card.
• If 'Approved': Download official PDF Enrollment Slip.
• View assigned section name & classroom number.
• Overview card shows today's scheduled classes.
• Active class banner with room countdown timer.
• Total student count & teaching unit sum.
• Click any slot to view detailed subject syllabus,
learning competencies, room, and section size.
• If assigned as Class Adviser: Section roster opens.
• Displays student list with LRN, Isnag, 4Ps tags.
• Click student row > Opens demographic dossier
• Click "Export SF-2 Attendance Sheet" > Downloads file.
• View DepEd plantilla item & employee number.
• Major academic specialization and advisory class.
• Filter by Grade, Track, Status, School Year.
• Search by Learner Reference Number or Name.
• Click any student row > Opens Split-Screen Modal:
Enter custom guidance remarks for the student.
• Progress bars visually display occupancy per section.
• Create sections, assign advisers and grade levels.
• One-click export of DepEd SF-1 Masterlists.
• Post emergency alert notices on student landing.
• Click "Activate Term" > Atomic RPC sets single
active term; deactivates previous term cleanly.
• Designate specialized science / TVL computer labs.
• View global user table across all 4 roles.
• Click "Invite Staff Member" > Enters email & role.
• Role switcher with privilege escalation locks.
• System security audit log with timestamps.
• PSA storage bucket quota utilization bar.

svg.text: Basic Education Online Admission & Academic Resource Management System
Proponents: Lozano, Digap, Julian, Magdaong, Tumpap | MMSU CCIS Department of Information Technology
